meaning.note: Read the complete original English article and the complete corrected Japanese source. terminology.note: Distinguished Euler identity from the general Euler formula, finite polynomial from convergent power series, imaginary part from i times that real value, probability amplitude from probability/density, and DFT/FFT from JPEG DCT. Used additive/multiplicative identities, radian measure, absolute convergence, antiderivative, phasor, sinusoidal steady state and rounding-free mathematical equalities consistently.

mathematics.note: Checked all thirteen displayed formulas against Japanese; original English had eight. Verified x real/radians, exp(z) single-valued series definition, z=0 separately from the ratio test, absolute convergence justifying even/odd grouping, signs of powers of i and x=pi substitution. Checked rotation direction for positive/negative angles, norm preservation and fixed origin. Explained nonzero-frequency antiderivative, termwise-calculus qualifications, linear/time-invariant single-frequency steady-state phasor assumptions, and normalized position-space probability density. Twenty-five exact coefficient checks, six exponential and nine rotation calculations are supplementary illustrations, not a proof for all x.
